m1_zero_omission_notes.summary: This chapter introduces decimal numbers as extensions of place value system to fractional parts: tenths (1/10 = 0.1), hundredths (1/100 = 0.01), and thousandths (1/1000 = 0.001). It covers measurement conversions, decimal place value charts, order comparisons, addition, and subtraction.

detailed_sections.full_notes: When 1 unit is divided into 10 equal parts, each part is one-tenth (1/10 or 0.1). When one-tenth is divided into 10 equal parts, each part is one-hundredth (1/100 or 0.01). Place values to the right of the decimal point are Tenths, Hundredths, Thousandths.

margin_notes.title: Decimal Point
margin_notes.content: The dot '.' separates whole units on the left from fractional place values on the right.

detailed_sections.full_notes: A number like 3.47 equals 3 ones + 4 tenths + 7 hundredths = 3 + 4/10 + 7/100. Money conversion: 1 Rupee = 100 Paise, so 1 Paise = ₹0.01. Length conversion: 1 cm = 10 mm, so 1 mm = 0.1 cm; 1 m = 1000 mm, 1 km = 1,000,000 mm.

Adding and subtracting decimals requires aligning decimal points vertically so identical place values (ones, tenths, hundredths) are operated together. Equivalent decimals (0.2 = 0.20 = 0.200) allow filling trailing zeros for alignment.

margin_notes.title: Alignment
margin_notes.content: Always align the decimal points before adding or subtracting.

m2_key_terms_formulas_and_rules.definition_or_expression: Adding trailing zeros to decimal places does not alter value

m3_practical_activities_and_procedures.activity_title: Measuring Objects with Scale and Tenths
m3_practical_activities_and_procedures.aim: To measure length using fractional tenths and decimal notation
procedure: Align object start with 0 on the scale.
Read whole centimeters and count remaining mm marks as tenths.
m3_practical_activities_and_procedures.observation_and_conclusion: Eraser = 2 cm 4 mm = 2.4 cm. Pencil = 4 cm 5 mm = 4.5 cm. Chalk = 1 cm 4 mm = 1.4 cm.

diagrams.instructions: Show ruler markings with zoomed-in section between 2 and 3 cm.
diagrams.structural_details: Illustrates division of 1 cm into 10 equal millimeter divisions.

end_exercises.question: A honeybee has Head = 2 3/10 units, Thorax = 5 4/10 units, Abdomen = 7 5/10 units. Find total length.
Celestial Pearl Danio length = 2.4 cm, Philippine Goby = 0.9 cm. Find difference.
Travel insurance costs 45 paise per passenger. If 1 lakh people opt in a day, find total fee.

extract_based.extract_text: Indian Railways travel insurance: 45 paise per passenger for 1 lakh passengers.

level_4_competency_case_study.scenario: A student measures three lab specimens: Specimen A = 5.5 cm, Specimen B = 6.4 cm, Specimen C = 6.39 cm.

qa.question: Which specimen is shortest, and what is the difference between the longest and shortest specimen?
qa.answer: Shortest specimen is A (5.50 cm). Longest is B (6.40 cm). Difference = 6.40 - 5.50 = 0.90 cm (9 mm).

m7_common_pitfalls.common_error: Comparing 0.2 and 0.09 incorrectly assuming 0.09 is larger because 9 > 2.
m7_common_pitfalls.correct_approach: Compare place values from left to right: 0.2 has 2 tenths, while 0.09 has 0 tenths. Therefore 0.2 > 0.09.
